tasks.description: The export button should be added to the sales report page. It should be visible and accessible to users. The button should initiate a download of the currently displayed report.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sales report page is loaded, when the user clicks the export button, then a download of the report is initiated.

tasks.description: The endpoint should generate the CSV for the requested report and stream the response to the client. This should be done in a way that memory usage stays bounded regardless of report size.
acceptance_criteria: Given a large report, when the export endpoint is called, then the response is streamed to the client without running out of memory.

tasks.description: The user should be able to choose which columns to include in the export before downloading. The generated CSV should include only the selected columns, in the displayed order.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sales report page is loaded, when the user selects columns to export, then the generated CSV includes only the selected columns in the correct order.

tasks.description: The CSV should be encoded per RFC 4180. This includes quoting fields containing commas, double quotes, or newlines, and escaping embedded double quotes by doubling them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a report with special characters, when the CSV is generated, then the special characters are correctly escaped according to RFC 4180.

tasks.description: The first row of the CSV should contain the human-readable column names for the selected columns.
acceptance_criteria: Given a report with selected columns, when the CSV is generated, then the first row includes the human-readable column names for the selected columns.

tasks.description: The export button should call the streaming export endpoint and initiate a download of the report.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sales report page is loaded, when the user clicks the export button, then the streaming export endpoint is called and a download of the report is initiated.
